arbolito.evidence: Complete English Red Cat Games publisher booklet for Arno Steinwenders Arbolito, matching named 405012 dexterity card-tree game. Two PDF spreads include all four printed pages. Both original spread images fully read: components, five initial branches, player-count setup/refill tables, matching-color one-handed hanging, fallen-card penalties and six-card cap, empty-branch/deck rules, all three animal effects and restrictions, two/three-acorn equal-turn ending and solo mode. Publisher current download is a localization master with YOUR LOGO placeholders, not labelled beta/draft. Automatic OCR misses many colored panels, so canonical text is a manually image-checked transcription with omissions limited to non-rule promotional/production material and diagram labels; original PDF unchanged and authoritative. No full summary audit or automatic Verified verdict.

big-adventure.evidence: Both original pages visually read. Code of Laws and List of Spaces are reference aids, lacking complete base setup, ordinary movement and victory procedures. Possible later-edition mismatch remains unresolved. Not counted as a main-rules recovery.

bug-race.evidence: Complete original Russian Rightgames 2014 Bug Race / Gonki zhukov rules, publicly linked by designers Trehgrannik. Both original pages fully read and visually checked against Russian OCR. Correct Alexey Konnov/Anatoly Shklyarov six-legged card-driven race, BGG 153571. Includes nine-piece cross-shaped board setup, six separate leg tokens per bug, body/leg adjacency and no-jumping restrictions, two-card draw/pass with alternating left/right direction, mandatory movement of marked legs where legal, body movement between individual leg moves, discard reshuffle, four-card advanced draft, full-body finish and rear/middle/front-leg tiebreak. Robot reverse sides cosmetic only. Minor OCR character/heading errors remain, and diagrams are authoritative in original PDF. Russian accepted under user language preference; no translation substituted or full summary audit. Concrete omitted-card/invented-dexterity contradictions recorded separately.
bug-race.previous_evidence: Correct Russian six-legged bug race publisher/retailer listing indexes a rules PDF, but page retrieval timed out and actual PDF href not yet obtained. No file or rules accepted.
